title: Atractylenolide-III alleviates osteoarthritis and chondrocyte senescence by targeting NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Xu, Yizhou; Hu, Xiaofang; Cai, Jiale; Li, Yunlun; Zou, Ying; Wang, Yihan; Xie, Changnan; Xu, Shuyi; Wang, Yanqing; Zheng, Yuli; Mahamat, Djibril Adam; Xu, Yuantao; Wang, Xianghai; Li, Xican; Liu, Aijun; Chen, Dongfeng; Zhu, Lixin; Guo, Jiasong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分AT-III通过NF-kappaB通路缓解骨关节炎和软骨细胞衰老，仅涉及分子对接预测靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Atractylenolide-III (AT-III) is well known as its role in antioxidant and anti-inflammatory. Present study was aimed to figure out its effects on osteoarthritis and potential mechanisms. Rat model, human osteoarthritis cartilage explants as well as rat/human chondrocyte cultures were prepared to test AT-III's effects on osteoarthritis progression and chondrocyte senescence. Potential targeted molecules of AT-III were predicted using network pharmacology and molecular docking, assessed by Western blotting and then verified with rescue experiments. AT-III treatment alleviated osteoarthritis severity (shown by OARSI grading score and micro-CT) and chondrocyte senescence (indexed by levels of SA-beta-gal, P16, P53, MMP13, ROS and ratio of healthy/collapsed mitochondrial membrane potentials). Network pharmacology and molecular docking suggested that AT-III might play role through NF-kappaB pathway. Further experiments revealed that AT-III reduced phosphorylation of IKKalpha/beta, IkappaBalpha and P65 in NF-kappaB pathway. As well as nuclear translocation of p65. Both in vivo and in vitro experiments indicated that AT-III's effects on osteoarthritis and anti-senescence were reversed by an NF-kappaB agonist. AT-III could alleviate osteoarthritis by inhibiting chondrocyte senescence through NF-kappaB pathway, which indicated that AT-III is a prospective drug for osteoarthritis treatment.
abstract_zh: 白术内酯-III（AT-III）以其抗氧化和抗炎作用而闻名。本研究旨在探讨其对骨关节炎的影响及潜在机制。制备了大鼠模型、人骨关节炎软骨外植体以及大鼠/人软骨细胞培养物，以测试AT-III对骨关节炎进展和软骨细胞衰老的影响。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测AT-III的潜在靶向分子，通过Western blotting评估，并通过拯救实验验证。AT-III治疗减轻了骨关节炎的严重程度（以OARSI评分和micro-CT显示）和软骨细胞衰老（以SA-beta-gal、P16、P53、MMP13、ROS水平及健康/塌陷线粒体膜电位比率衡量）。网络药理学和分子对接提示AT-III可能通过NF-kappaB通路发挥作用。进一步实验显示，AT-III降低了NF-kappaB通路中IKKalpha/beta、IkappaBalpha和P65的磷酸化，以及p65的核转位。体内和体外实验均表明，AT-III对骨关节炎和抗衰老的作用被NF-kappaB激动剂逆转。AT-III可通过NF-kappaB通路抑制软骨细胞衰老来缓解骨关节炎，这表明AT-III是治疗骨关节炎的潜在药物。
